summary: Once per turn, inflicting a condition also applies two turns of Encrusted with Frost.

fields.Coldbrim Chill: Once per turn, inflicting a condition also applies 2 turns of Encrusted with Frost. Pinned notes report some hidden effects qualify, including certain misses.
fields.Encrusted with Frost: Disadvantage on Dexterity saves. At 7 or more turns, DC 12 Constitution. The reported effect is Frozen for 2 turns on failure or 1d4 Cold on success. Frost then clears and Burning also removes it.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details and pinned item and rules evidence.
